I found 10 possible episodes. Two things to know first:

- **I couldn't find @ashutoshwithclaude or @canwebuildthis in search**, so there's nothing new on what's working for them this month. Someone needs to check their latest reels in the app.
- **Don't use Google Interview Warmup as a free job fix.** Several 2026 reports say Google shut it down in April 2026.

## Episode options (in this week's planned order)

1. **REAL FIX: fake offer letter.** Hook: "Offer letter. Rs 1,500 fee. 0 interviews." Freshers are getting offers with no interview that ask for a fee, and police warned about this on 18 Oct. **Fix:** no real employer charges a fee. Check the job on the company's own careers page, and report the number on Chakshu inside [sancharsaathi.gov.in](https://sancharsaathi.gov.in) (also in its app). Source: [UNI](https://www.uniindia.com/north-india/crime-haryana-fake-recruitment-scams/218230). AI joke: Gemini congratulates her and announces the "new job" to everyone.

2. **AFTER HOURS · PART 1: boss texts during Diwali.** Hook: "Boss texted at 11:47 pm. On Diwali." Two bills on a "right to disconnect" are pending, one in Parliament and one in Kerala, but neither is law. **Fix (not legal advice):** your phone's Do Not Disturb or Focus mode, with only family allowed through, plus "schedule send" so your reply goes out at 9 am. Source: [Drishti IAS](https://www.drishtiias.com/daily-updates/daily-news-analysis/right-to-disconnect-bill-2026). AI joke: Claude drafts a 400-word reply to "ok?". ⚠️ I didn't check the official help pages for these features, so get the links before using it.

3. **REAL FIX: hunting with no reply.** Hook: "87 applications. 0 replies." Fresher hiring is frozen or deferred at big IT firms, with batches from 2023 to 2025 still waiting. **Fix:** [ncs.gov.in](https://www.ncs.gov.in), the free government job portal, which charges no fee at any stage and lists job fairs under "Events". Source: [Outlook Business](https://www.outlookbusiness.com/deeptech/artificial-intelligence/shrinking-fresher-hiring-could-close-its-golden-pathway-for-tier-2-tier-3-youth-fite-maharashtra-president). AI joke: Codex answers "Applied to all 6,000."

4. **MUM ASKS: Diwali gift link.** Hook: "Rs 1,000 Diwali gift. 1 link." Mum's Hinglish text: "Beta ye 1000 wala gift sach hai kya??" Police in Hyderabad, Ludhiana, Delhi and Maharashtra (5 Nov) are warning about fake gift links on WhatsApp, some using fake "I really got it" messages. **Fix:** don't click. Report the message on Chakshu, and if money is lost, call **1930** or go to [cybercrime.gov.in](https://cybercrime.gov.in). Sources: [Telangana Today](https://telanganatoday.com/hyderabad-police-warn-against-fake-paytm-diwali-gift-messages), [Live Nagpur](https://thelivenagpur.com/2026/11/05/beware-of-festive-scams-maharashtra-cyber-police-warn-against-fraudulent-diwali-links/). Claude's analogy: "No shopkeeper gives free mithai and then asks for your locker key."

5. **MUM ASKS (backup): voice clone.** Hook: "Mum got a call in MY voice." A McAfee survey found 66% of Indians would likely react to an urgent money call from a "relative". **Fix:** a family code word, then hang up and call back on the number you have saved. Source: [Scroll](https://scroll.in/article/1066442/family-member-in-distress-or-an-ai-voice-clone-the-rise-of-a-disturbing-new-cyber-crime-scam). This is close to 058, so use it only if #4 doesn't work out.

6. **REAL FIX: someone wants your UPI PIN.** Hook: "Rs 5,000 'request'. 1 PIN." Scammers ask you to enter your PIN to "receive" money. **Fix:** your PIN only ever sends money out, never brings it in. NPCI also stopped person-to-person collect requests from 1 Oct 2025, so a stranger's "request" is a trap. Sources: [Outlook Money](https://www.outlookmoney.com/banking/npci-to-end-upi-p2p-collect-requests-from-october-1-to-reduce-fraud), [Jupiter](https://jupiter.money/blog/how-to-stay-safe-from-upi-fraud/). Codex's honest line: "PIN means money leaves." I didn't find a reversal of the NPCI rule, but I also found nothing confirming the rollout after October 2025.

7. **AI RUNS MY SHOP: fake payment screenshot.** Hook: "Orders: 1. Paid: Rs 0." It's Diwali candle rush, and a buyer sends a "payment successful" screenshot. **Fix:** ship only after the money shows in your own bank or UPI app, and match the UTR number. Source: [PhonePe Business guide](https://business.phonepe.com/articles/fake-upi-payment-scams-how-to-identify-and-prevent-fraud). AI joke: Gemini has already shipped 40 candles.

8. **REAL FIX: SIMs in your name.** Hook: "Up to 9 SIMs can be in your name." **Fix:** on [sancharsaathi.gov.in](https://sancharsaathi.gov.in), open "Know Your Mobile Connections", log in with an OTP, and mark any number that isn't yours as "Not my number". Source: [Digit](https://www.digit.in/how-to/general/is-someone-using-a-sim-card-in-your-name-follow-these-quick-steps-to-find-out.html). AI joke: Claude worries about all 9 of them separately.

9. **REAL FIX: electricity cut "tonight".** Hook: "Power cut at 9:30 pm. Pay now." Power companies in Maharashtra and Delhi say they never send payment links from personal numbers, and a Delhi doctor lost Rs 6 lakh to one. **Fix:** pay only through the power company's own app or site, and report the SMS on Chakshu. Source: [The Print](https://theprint.in/india/electricity-bill-scam-delhi-discoms-urge-consumers-to-exercise-caution-follow-safety-tips/2167243).

10. **REAL FIX or MUM ASKS: Papa's life certificate.** Hook: "Papa's pension. 1 form. 30 days." Pensioners submit their life certificate in November. **Fix:** do it free from home with the official face app at [jeevanpramaan.gov.in](https://jeevanpramaan.gov.in). It needs the Aadhaar face app first, and Android 7 or newer. Source: [Outlook Retirement](https://retirement.outlookindia.com/spend/senior-living/generate-life-certificatevia-face-verification-heres-a-guide). I didn't confirm this year's dates on the portal.

**Appraisal (spare):** Aon expects a 9.1% average raise in 2027, after 9% in 2026. The fix is a method: AI turns your year into a one-page list of wins. Hook: "9.1% average hike. Mine: 3%." Source: [Aon](https://www.aon.com/apac/in-the-press/asia-newsroom/2026/aon-study-finds-salaries-in-india-projected-to-fise-9-1-in-2027-employers-balance-growth-and-cost-pressures).

## Dates in the next 10 days
- **8 Nov:** Diwali (tomorrow). **9 Nov:** Govardhan Puja. **10 or 11 Nov:** Bhai Dooj (sources disagree, so check a local calendar).
- **13–16 Nov:** Chhath, with the main day on 15 Nov. **14 Nov:** Children's Day.
- **13 Nov:** last day to apply for RRB NTPC Undergraduate (fee by 15 Nov). **18 Nov:** NEET SS closes.
- **CAT is on 29 Nov**, and admit cards are reportedly out on [iimcat.ac.in](https://iimcat.ac.in). These exam dates come from coaching and job sites, so check the official portals.

## Real AI habits to joke about
A Science paper (March 2026) found AI chatbots side with users 49% more than people do, and "You're absolutely right!" hit the front page of Reddit's ChatGPT forum on 7 March. Use it as Claude agreeing that the gift link "might be real" the moment Mum pushes back ([Fortune](https://fortune.com/2026/03/31/ai-tech-sycophantic-regulations-openai-chatgpt-gemini-claude-anthropic-american-politics/)).
